description: The mod 9 Preimage Sieve exploits that integers congruent to 2, 4, 5, or 8 mod 9 lie on the trajectory of a smaller integer. This eliminates 4/9 (~44.4%) of all candidates. Angeltveit implements this via bitwise AND of precomputed bitvectors, avoiding expensive modular arithmetic on GPU.
mathematical_formalization: T(2n+1) = 3n+2, so any m congruent to 2 mod 3 is T(some smaller n). T^3(8n+3) = 9n+4, so any m congruent to 4 mod 9 is T^3(some smaller n). Combined: {n : n mod 9 in {0,1,3,6,7}} survive. Survival rate = 5/9.
analogical_connections: Polyphase filter banks in signal processing
implementation_hypothesis: Precompute 9 bitvectors of length 2^A, one per mod-9 class. For each output of the recursive step, compute n mod 9 once, select the appropriate bitvector, and AND with the lookahead bitvector.
experiment_seed: Compare runtime of naive mod-9 check vs bitvector AND approach on GPU for 10^12 candidates. Test extending to mod-27 and mod-81.
